title: Phantom Blade Zero Trophy List - All 36 PS5 Trophies
description: Every trophy in Phantom Blade Zero by tier - 36 in total - with what each one wants and whether it can be lost. Each entry links to its own page.
keyword: phantom blade zero trophy list, all trophies, ps5 trophies, achievements

sections.title: The Full List, by Tier
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero has 36 trophies on PS5: one platinum, three gold, fourteen silver and eighteen bronze. Nothing is gated behind a difficulty setting, and the director confirmed every trophy can be earned in a single playthrough - which makes this a list about not missing content rather than about skill.

Tiers for the grouped boss trophies are disputed between sources; the split below follows the four lists that agree, and the trophy guide records where they diverge.

sections.title: Where the Lists Disagree
sections.content:
Four sources agree on 36 with a 1 / 3 / 14 / 18 split. Fextralife lists 66 for the combined PS5-and-PC set with a 1 / 3 / 22 / 40 split, which is the Steam-style count rather than a contradiction.

Two smaller disputes are recorded rather than resolved. Game8 lists a silver called Unsung Legend for completing the Enemy Journal where the other lists carry Collector's Notes for 30 accessories - the likeliest explanation is that the platform lists differ, not that one source is wrong. And Game8 marks 13 trophies hidden while the Chinese list marks more; only the 13 both support are labelled hidden on this site.
